title: Forgot your Wi-Fi password ?
description:
Forgot your Wi-Fi password? Windows may already have it saved.

Open PowerShell and run:

netsh wlan show profile name="DemoWiFi" key=clear

Replace DemoWiFi with your saved network name, then look for “Key Content.”

Use this only for Wi-Fi networks saved on your own computer. The password shown in this video is only a demonstration.Title
